content:
Amir: Quick note: proposing a "geo-write soft-ack" pattern for tenants who want local latency guarantees but accept eventual canonicalization. Not full active/active, more like local write + replay.

Noemi: Need to be explicit: legal/product must sign off. If a tenant requires strict residency, this can't be default.

Chen: Runtime idea: add a per-tenant control flag `geo_write=soft_ack`. Local node writes to encrypted escrow queue and returns 200. Separate replay worker streams to canonical region. Metadata: escrow_seq + origin_region.

Amir: Important ops requirements: visibility into per-tenant backlog, ability to pause replay, and safe-drain before toggling off.

Noemi: UX/API: offer two write options `write(mode=soft_ack)` and `write(mode=strict)`; default strict. Docs show semantics and recommended idempotency keys.

Chen: Conflict resolution: deterministic comparator using (client_ts, escrow_seq, origin_region) and default LWW. Offer customer merge-hook for complex merges.

Amir: Telemetry: emit `metric.geo_write_backlog{tenant}`, `metric.geo_write_replay_latency` and trace header `x-geo-origin`. Also surface replay failures in tenant audit log.

Noemi: Test plan: small pilot (1 EU tenant), partition primary, verify p99 improvement and that replay succeeds within SLO (target 30s). Have rollback playbook.

ops-bot: Runbook created: https://wiki/redwood/ops/geo-write-soft-ack (owner needed).

Chen: I'll spike a shim for enqueue/replay and add basic metrics. ETA 4d.

Amir: I'll coordinate legal/customer onboarding and draft contract appendix. Reconvene after spike.

Noemi: +1 :thumbsup:
